description: This file defines the TextGrid class within the PhpSpreadsheet helper namespace. It provides functionality for rendering a 2D matrix of data as a text-based grid, suitable for CLI or HTML display. The class includes methods for rendering headers, rows, cells, and footers, as well as calculating column widths for proper alignment.

classes.name: TextGrid
classes.description: A helper class for rendering a matrix of data as a formatted text grid for CLI or HTML display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextGrid with a matrix of data and an optional flag indicating CLI or HTML display.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the data matrix as a formatted text grid and returns the resulting string.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders all rows of the grid, including row labels and cell data.

methods.name: renderCells
methods.description: Renders individual cells within a row, formatting based on CLI or HTML display mode.

methods.name: renderColumnHeader
methods.description: Renders the column headers for the grid, including underlines.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer line of the grid, including row and column separators.

methods.name: getColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates and returns the widths for each column based on data content.

methods.name: getColumnWidth
methods.description: Determines the maximum width needed for a single column based on its data.
